findings: WRONG (claim after eq. 3.8): the sentence that rho < 0 implies Delta > 1 fails for the paper's own vac+2 family (2.15) with Delta as defined in (3.2): exact Fock-space moments give Delta = |1 - (2eps - sqrt2 cos2theta)^2/(3(1+eps^2))|, and z3 proves no member has rho < 0 and Delta > 1; in fact 1/3 < Delta < 1 wherever rho < 0 (witness eps = 1/10, theta = 0: exact 0.5134 against 2.0118 from printed (3.8)). Not a misprint: the sentence follows validly from printed (3.8).

WRONG (eq. 3.8): printed (10eps + sqrt2 cos2theta)/(12eps) is negative (-0.3452 at eps = 1/10, cos2theta = -1) although (3.2) defines Delta as an absolute value, and it is linear in cos2theta where (3.2) gives a quadratic; no combination of printed (2.16) and (3.7) reproduces it.

DISCREPANCY, not WRONG (eq. 3.7, same key): printed <:T00^2:> differs from the exact 12K^2 eps^2/(1+eps^2) by a factor 1/(1+eps^2) (state normalisation squared); on its own a slip a misprint could explain, and not the basis of the WRONG grade.

WRONG (qualitative conclusion; abstract 'We find in all cases studied that the energy density fluctuations are large whenever the local energy density is negative', Sec. III.B 'we always have that Delta is at least of order unity'): in KF's own case (ii), the displaced squeezed state at theta = pi/2, gamma = delta = 0, |alpha|^2 = (1 - e^{-2r})/8, gives rho = K sinh r (sinh r - cosh r) < 0 with <:T00^2:> = rho^2 identically, so Delta = 0 exactly (r = 1: rho = -0.4323 K, numeric Delta 2e-14). The headline sentence is READ in the journal's own abstract, so this point does not need M's comparison.

DISCREPANCY (eq. 2.16): the final line is exactly half the middle line (dropped overall factor 2); the middle line and (2.10) are exact; sign of rho and the condition cos2theta > sqrt2 eps unaffected.

DISCREPANCY (eqs. 3.19, 3.23): both disagree with the exact result ((3.23) vs 6K^2 s^2[c^2 cos4theta + 4sc cos2theta + 3s^2 + 1] in three coefficients); (3.19) breaks the exact U(1) phase symmetry, and (3.19) at alpha = delta = 0 does not give (3.23); (3.18), (3.22) exact.

DISCREPANCY (eqs. 3.41-3.42): coefficient 1/2 printed where the operator identity phidot^2 = (rho + sum p)/2 requires 1/4; non-propagating - (3.43)'s 1/8 and the printed 1/2, 1/3, 6, 6/7 are the 1/4 values.

DISCREPANCY (eq. 3.43): a leading 'rho' inside each bracket where '1' is required; read literally its value at xi = 0 is rho^2/2, contradicting KF's next sentence ('minimum ... is 1/2'); does not affect (3.45); possibly text-layer.

DISCREPANCY, minor: the printed condition cos2theta > sqrt2 eps for rho < 0 is exact only for eps > 0 while eps is stated real; for eps < 0 it reverses (z3 counter-point); equivalent to a theta shift of pi/2, nothing physical moves.

sources.paper: Galanda, Meda, Murro, Pinamonti, Schmid (GMMPS), 'The Semiclassical Einstein-Klein-Gordon System: Asymptotic Analysis of Minkowski Spacetime'
sources.version_read: arXiv:2604.01047v1 [math-ph], 1 Apr 2026: alphaXiv answer_pdf_queries page text (pp. 1, 7, 9, 22-23, 27, 31-33, 35-40, 58-63) and the v1 full-text layer from DOCKET 64 (galanda.txt, md5 4bac4a9400afceac615c5aa3b9f83c6e); live re-read 2026-10-02. findings: WRONG, Theorem 3.6, S half only: the S-half derivation evaluates (3.21) with the renormalisation scale mu held fixed relative to the background; in the late region (Omega^2 eta, constant Omega = 1 + W, mass m) the dilation x -> Omega x is an isometry onto Minkowski with the same m, the paper's convergence step puts the state in the vacuum, and general local covariance (invoked by the theorem, and used by the paper's own TT procedure on p. 39 with the same mu) gives <T> = 0 at every order in W via Omega^2 H_g(m, mu) = H_eta(Omega m, Omega mu); inserting 0 into the p. 37 comparison gives alpha~^S_1 = 0, not the printed 1/(64 pi^2), whose m^4 term equals dT_vac/d log mu^2. Not a misprint: the paper's algebra reproduces 1/(64 pi^2) from (3.21) exactly, and p. 36 derives (3.22) with no compensating term. An inconsistency inside the paper's procedure; it does not say the instability is wrong in general, nor that AMM is right in general.

DISCREPANCY (p. 23): '[w_0] = m^2/16pi^2, [w_1] = m^4/64pi^2' are evidently the v coefficients (p. 39 prints them as [v_0], [v_1]); inserted literally into (3.3), [v_1] does not give Prop. 3.1's alpha_1 (off by (8pi^2 - 1)/(256 pi^4)); convention or typo undecidable; alpha_1 stands.

DISCREPANCY, misprint (Sec. 5.1, p. 59): alpha~^S_1 printed (64 pi)^-1 against Thm 3.6's 1/(64 pi^2); Sec. 5.3's printed m ~ 7.8e-3 eV is reproduced only with 1/(64 pi^2) (7.885e-3); (64 pi)^-1 gives 5.92e-3 (-24.1%); ratio exactly pi^(1/4).

DISCREPANCY (Sec. 5.1): 'For sufficiently large -b_2, this is the only negative zero' fails on the printed b_i (b_2 < 0 gives a second negative zero, e.g. two at -1.08e120, and none real below about b_2 = -8.6e120, m = 1 units); it holds for b_2 > 0, agreeing with Fig. 1 and 5.2.1; probably a sign slip.
DISCREPANCY (under (5.3)): 'equals Q(-w) for xi = -w^2' drops a sign (F_S(-w^2) = -Q(w^2)) and reuses xi, the coupling's name; zeros unaffected.

DISCREPANCY, gap in the source (TT sector, Sec. 5.2/p. 62): a = 4m^2 is the endpoint Prop. 4.12 excludes and lies outside Thm 4.14's open range, yet Thm 4.14 is cited; Sec. 5.2 skips h_0 because b_0 = 0 while p. 62 invokes Prop. 4.10 (needs b_0 != 0) for TT. Unique past-compact existence is proved at source for the S sector only.

DISCREPANCY (Thm 1.2, p. 11): (i) bound printed 'h~ <= e^{-Ht} eta' for a solution said to grow (5.2.1: Omega = e^{-Ht} removes growth; e^{tH} meant); (ii) 'any nontrivial source ... grows' claims more than Thm 4.16 ('for some ranges') and conflicts with 5.2's own Planck-mass TT example (all zeros >= 0); (iii) Thm 1.2 and (1.9) print Sigma_eps where (1.8) has Sigma_-eps; (iv) Prop. 4.5 writes '1 < c < 4m^2' for a constant of dimension mass^2.

DISCREPANCY (Sec. 1.5 vs 5.2.1): 1.5 says 'regardless of renormalisation constants', 5.2.1 attributes the behaviour to Thm 3.6's choice; computation supports 5.2.1 (branch zero vanishes at alpha~^S_1 = 0).

DISCREPANCY, misprints: (4.31) and the Thm 4.16 proof write 'gamma in Z' with G^gamma_ret, Q'(-gamma), S^(+-sqrt gamma, 0), inconsistent with Z as zeros of Q in w^2; the proof writes Z within (-4m^2, inf) for the decay estimate (statement governs); p. 62 'cat' for 'cut'.
sources.stands: Thm 3.6's TT half (alpha~^TT_1 = 0) and Prop. 3.1's alpha_1 STAND; dispersion functions (3.11), (3.16), (4.9) -> (4.30) re-derive; F_S(-w^2) = -Q(w^2); rho and J ((4.5), (4.17)) exact; Thm 4.16's growth clause; S-sector existence via Thm 4.14 for a < 4m^2; Sec. 5.3's matching formula and Planck inputs (copied correctly to 3 s.f.); Sec. 5.2's TT 'always negative' (computed kappa m^2 < 360 pi^2). Downstream, 5.1's S zero and 5.3's gamma_0 and m ~ 8 meV rest on alpha~^S_1 = 1/(64 pi^2) and fall with the S half; at alpha~^S_1 = 0, gamma = 0 is an exact root.
